documentation: Deterministic veto. A proposal is data. No field in it can skip a check. decision APY is DefiLlama apyBase when that number is finite, otherwise apy. grossSpreadBps = round((destApy - sourceApy) * 100). oneTimeCostBps = feeBps + slippageToleranceBps. feeBps is unauthenticatedFeeBps unless ONECLICK_API_KEY is set, in which case a USDC-to-USDC move uses stablecoinRouteFeeBps. Those two fee numbers are the 1Click schedule at https://docs.near-intents.org/resources/fees.md (25 bps unauthenticated, 1 bp authenticated stablecoin or same-asset). annualizedCostBps = round(oneTimeCostBps * 365 / assumedHoldDays). netSpreadBps = grossSpreadBps - annualizedCostBps. paybackDays = oneTimeCostBps * 365 / grossSpreadBps. On 2026-11-10 a dry EXACT_INPUT quote for 10 USDC from Base to NEAR returned a price, and 25 USDC and 1000 USDC returned 'No liquidity available'. maxMoveUsd is the hard cap, set at the size the API would quote.
